items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person's photo, or their initials when there's no photo.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A short label for status, category or count.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Triggers an action or event with a single click.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for picking a day or a range, with full keyboard use; pages side by side, scrolls on phones, or fills a page with a month of events.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: chapter-scrubber
items.title: Chapter scrubber
items.description: A rail of marks that swell under the pointer like the Dock, previewing the chapter at the crest.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: chat-composer
items.title: Chat composer
items.description: A message box built from parts around one draft, so each chat surface composes its own.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Turns a single option on or off, or picks many from a list.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command menu
items.description: A Cmd+K palette with nested pages, recent commands, ranked search and a preview pane.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: count
items.title: Count
items.description: A number at a glance: capped at 99+, shortened to 1.2K or signed as +4, read out in full.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: A table for lists people work through, on TanStack Table: sorting, search, filters with counts, pages, selection, cell types, locked rows and pinned columns.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: A field that opens a calendar to pick a day, or a range with presets and Apply; a popover on desktop, a drawer on phones.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: What shows where content would be: a title, why it's empty, and what to do next.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A label, description and error wired to one form control, with a group that sets the size of a whole form.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: filter-menu
items.title: Filter menu
items.description: A filter menu of fields and values that turns into a search as you type.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: floating-nav
items.title: Floating nav
items.description: A pill of destinations that floats above the bottom of a phone screen and steps aside while you scroll.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input group
items.description: An input with an icon, text or button beside it, drawn as one field.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single line of free text.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: integration-visual
items.title: Integration visual
items.description: A hub and the tools wired into it, with pulses along the routes.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: jump-bar
items.title: Jump bar
items.description: Takes people to unread messages, new messages or the present in a conversation.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Shows a key or a keyboard shortcut in text.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Names a form control and widens its hit area.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: map-pin
items.title: Map pin
items.description: A pin for a point on a map, with a preview that opens on click or tap.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: A short list of actions that opens from a button.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: message-list
items.title: Message list
items.description: A conversation that groups each person's messages under one heading, with a single tab stop.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Moves through a long list one page at a time.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: pixel-snail
items.title: Pixel snail
items.description: A one-colour pixel snail that crawls on a loop while something loads.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Shows how far a task has got, or that it's under way.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: Picks exactly one option from a short list.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: reactions
items.title: Reactions
items.description: Lets people respond to content with an emoji in one tap.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: rich-text-editor
items.title: Rich text editor
items.description: Formatted writing on Tiptap: headings, marks, lists, quotes and links from a toolbar or Markdown shortcuts, with an optional character limit.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Picks one option from a list that opens on demand.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A thin rule between groups of content, across or down, with an optional label.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge for a focused task.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder in the shape of content that's still loading.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Picks a number, or a range, by dragging along a track.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A spinning ring that says something is loading.
items.author: Tori Bryan
items.docs:
Deprecated in 0.2.0 and removed in 0.3.0. Use Progress (@fibo/progress) instead.
Migrate: pnpm dlx jscodeshift --parser tsx -t https://fibo.toribryan.com/codemods/spinner-to-progress.js src
Docs and live examples: https://fibo.toribryan.com/?path=/docs/base-components-feedback-spinner--docs

deprecated.reason: A spinner says nothing about how long a wait will be or what is happening. An indeterminate Progress takes a label, and turns determinate once the total is known.

items.name: status-dot
items.title: Status dot
items.description: A small mark for whether someone is present, away or offline, told apart by shape.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: sticker-avatar
items.title: Sticker avatar
items.description: An avatar cut out like a die-cut sticker, with a paper edge that follows its shape and a status told by shape.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Turns a setting on or off, taking effect at once.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows and columns of data, at one compact density.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switches between views of one subject in place, as a segmented control or a row of tabs with an underline; scrolls sideways when it runs out of room.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Several lines of free text that grow with the content.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A brief message in the corner about something that just happened.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: token-flow
items.title: Token flow
items.description: Walks a colour token from raw value to primitive to semantic role.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label that appears when a control is hovered or focused.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: typing-indicator
items.title: Typing indicator
items.description: Says who's typing in a conversation, naming up to three people.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: voice-memo
items.title: Voice memo
items.description: An aluminium recorder that writes down what you say, with the transcript filling in beside it as you talk.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: fibo's full token set, light and dark: the achromatic roles, status colours and named -subtle, -hover and -ring roles.
items.author: Tori Bryan

items.name: theme-mechanical
items.title: Mechanical theme
items.description: A warm, tactile theme: a beige page, a terracotta primary, and raised controls that press onto a solid bottom edge like keys. Applies under data-theme="mechanical", in light and dark. Uses IBM Plex Sans, which your app loads.
items.author: Tori Bryan
items.docs: Set data-theme="mechanical" on <html>, or on any element for one region. Docs: https://fibo.toribryan.com/?path=/docs/foundations-themes--docs

[data-theme=\"mechanical\"].--font-sans: "IBM Plex Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

items.name: theme-electrical
items.title: Electrical theme
items.description: A flat, ledger-like theme: a sage page, white cards, ink buttons and one yellow highlight on whatever is selected. Applies under data-theme="electrical", in light and dark. Uses Inter Tight, which your app loads.
items.author: Tori Bryan
items.docs: Set data-theme="electrical" on <html>, or on any element for one region. Docs: https://fibo.toribryan.com/?path=/docs/foundations-themes--docs

[data-theme=\"electrical\"].--font-sans: "Inter Tight", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
